# uptimekuma_notification_alerta (Resource)

Alerta notification resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uptimekuma_notification_alerta" "example" {
  name          = "Alerta Notifications"
  api_endpoint  = "https://alerta.example.com"
  api_key       = "your-alerta-api-key"
  environment   = "production"
  alert_state   = "alert"
  recover_state = "ok"
  is_active     = true
  is_default    = false
}

resource "uptimekuma_notification_alerta" "staging" {
  name          = "Alerta Staging"
  api_endpoint  = "https://alerta-staging.example.com"
  api_key       = "your-staging-api-key"
  environment   = "staging"
  alert_state   = "critical"
  recover_state = "resolved"
  is_active     = true
  is_default    = false
}

# Requires Terraform or OpenTofu 1.11 or later: api_key_wo is never stored in
# plan or state. Change api_key_wo_version whenever the secret changes.
resource "uptimekuma_notification_alerta" "write_only" {
  name = "Alerta with a write-only secret"

  api_endpoint = "https://alerta.example.com"

  api_key_wo         = "your-alerta-api-key"
  api_key_wo_version = "1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `api_endpoint` (String) Alerta API endpoint
- `name` (String) Notification name

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `alert_state` (String) Alert state for incoming alerts
- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Alerta API key. Stored in state; use `api_key_wo` to keep it out of state.
- `api_key_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Alerta API key, write-only: sent to Uptime Kuma on create and update but never stored in plan or state. Requires Terraform 1.11 or OpenTofu 1.11 or later. Conflicts with `api_key`; requires `api_key_wo_version`. An imported resource has no `api_key_wo_version` yet, so `terraform import` may store the server's value in `api_key` until the next apply with `api_key_wo` set removes it from state.
- `api_key_wo_version` (String) Any value that changes whenever `api_key_wo` changes, for example a counter or a hash of the secret's encrypted source. A change triggers an update that sends the current `api_key_wo`.
- `apply_existing` (Boolean)
- `environment` (String) Alerta environment
- `is_active` (Boolean)
- `is_default` (Boolean)
- `recover_state` (String) Alert state for recovered alerts

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Notification identifier
